1	# InkOS Onboarding v2 — Design Spec
2	
3	**Produced by:** Vega (Design Lead)
4	**Date:** 2026-04-24
5	**For:** Koda (implementation), Sage (review gate)
6	**Plan source:** `~/.claude/plans/for-onboaring-lets-optimize-virtual-karp.md`
7	**Brand authority:** `CLAUDE.md §4` + `app/globals.css @theme inline`
8	
9	---
10	
11	## Brand-Safety Reminder
12	
13	The entire InkOS palette is exactly four colors. Every pixel in every component below must use only these four, via CSS tokens — never raw hex, never inline styles with color values.
14	
15	| Token (Tailwind utility) | CSS variable | Hex | Role |
16	|---|---|---|---|
17	| `bg-bone` / `text-bone` | `var(--color-bone)` | `#F7F7F5` | Page canvas, card surfaces, text-on-dark |
18	| `bg-onyx` / `text-onyx` | `var(--color-onyx)` | `#0F0F0F` | Primary text, primary CTAs, completed states |
19	| `bg-stone` / `text-stone` | `var(--color-stone)` | `#787774` | Secondary text, labels, borders, inactive states |
20	| `bg-rust` / `text-rust` | `var(--color-rust)` | `#B23A2B` | Active step (only), one accent per viewport |
21	
22	`bg-border` resolves to the Stone-tinted border token `oklch(91% 0.005 85)` — use it for connector lines and inactive borders.
23	
24	**Rust budget per viewport: once or twice maximum.** On the onboarding card the active `StepIndicator` circle is the one Rust element. The "Most studios pick this" dot in `ServiceTemplatePicker` is the second. Nothing else uses Rust anywhere in the onboarding flow.
25	
26	---
27	
28	## DO NOT USE List
29	
30	Any of the following in onboarding components is a hard Sage block:
31	
32	- `shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`, `shadow-lg`, `shadow-xl`, `shadow-2xl` — Tailwind defaults; use named tokens
33	- `bg-white` — use `bg-bone`
34	- `bg-black` — use `bg-onyx`
35	- `bg-card` — permitted on inner card surfaces only where it resolves to white; on the wizard outer card use `bg-bone`
36	- `bg-purple-*`, `bg-blue-*`, `bg-green-*`, `bg-teal-*`, `bg-success`, `bg-warning`, `bg-accent` as a fill
37	- Raw hex literals in any `.tsx` file
38	- `style={{ color: '...' }}` with any color value
39	- `oklch(...)` directly in component files — only `globals.css` holds raw color values
40	- `bg-primary` on non-CTA elements (primary = Onyx, which is correct for buttons but wrong for backgrounds)
41	- `text-destructive` used as a general red accent — destructive is reserved for error/delete states only
42	- `animate-spin`, `animate-bounce`, `animate-pulse` — none of these belong in the onboarding flow
43	- Gradients of any kind
44	
45	---
46	
47	## 1. StepIndicator
48	
49	**File:** `components/onboarding/StepIndicator.tsx`
50	
51	**Purpose:** Horizontal 4-circle + 3-connector progress bar that communicates the user's position in the 4-step wizard. Brand-safe replacement for the current purple/green CSS classes in `app/globals.css` (lines 1656–1667, which must be deleted).
52	
53	### Layout
54	
55	```
56	Desktop (sm and above):
57	
58	  [●] ——————— [●] ——————— [●] ——————— [●]
59	  Your         One          Your         Live.
60	  studio.      location.    first
61	               to start.    service.
62	
63	Mobile (below sm — 375px viewport):
64	
65	  [·] — [·] — [·] — [·]     Step 2 of 4
66	```
67	
68	Desktop: full horizontal row with circles, connectors, and labels.
69	Mobile: circles shrink to 6×6 dots (no labels, no connectors as lines — dots separated by `mx-1` gaps), followed by Inter 12px/600 Stone text "Step N of 4" positioned to the right via `flex items-center justify-between`.
70	
71	**Decision — dots-only mobile (not shrunk circles):** On a 375px viewport a row of four 6×6 dots plus the "Step N of 4" label fits in one `flex items-center` row at 44px total height without overflow. Shrunk 24px circles (down from 32px desktop) would still crowd labels. Dots are cleaner and faster to scan. The "Step N of 4" text preserves orientation without requiring labels.
72	
73	### Circle dimensions
74	
75	| Breakpoint | Circle size | Tailwind classes |
76	|---|---|---|
77	| `<sm` (mobile, dots-only mode) | 6×6px | `size-1.5` |
78	| `sm` and above | 32×32px | `size-8` |
79	
80	### State classes
81	
82	#### Active (current step)
83	
84	```
85	Container:  size-8 rounded-full bg-rust flex items-center justify-center
86	            transition-all duration-200 ease-out
87	            shadow-[0_0_0_4px_color-mix(in_oklch,var(--color-rust)_12%,transparent)]
88	
89	Number:     text-bone font-sans text-[13px] font-semibold leading-none tabular-nums
90	```
91	
92	Full class string for the circle div:
93	`size-8 rounded-full bg-rust flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-200 ease-out shadow-[0_0_0_4px_color-mix(in_oklch,var(--color-rust)_12%,transparent)]`
94	
95	#### Completed (step index < current step)
96	
97	```
98	Container:  size-8 rounded-full bg-onyx flex items-center justify-center
99	            transition-all duration-200 ease-out
100	
101	Icon:       Lucide CheckIcon, size-4, text-bone stroke-width={2.5}
102	```
103	
104	Full class string for the circle div:
105	`size-8 rounded-full bg-onyx flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-200 ease-out`
106	
107	The check icon: `<CheckIcon className="size-4 text-bone" strokeWidth={2.5} />`
108	
109	#### Future (step index > current step)
110	
111	```
112	Container:  size-8 rounded-full bg-bone border border-border flex items-center justify-center
113	            transition-all duration-200 ease-out
114	
115	Number:     text-stone font-sans text-[13px] font-semibold leading-none tabular-nums
116	```
117	
118	Full class string for the circle div:
119	`size-8 rounded-full bg-bone border border-border flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-200 ease-out`
120	
121	#### Mobile dot states
122	
123	| State | Classes |
124	|---|---|
125	| Active | `size-1.5 rounded-full bg-rust transition-all duration-200 ease-out` |
126	| Completed | `size-1.5 rounded-full bg-onyx transition-all duration-200 ease-out` |
127	| Future | `size-1.5 rounded-full bg-bone border border-stone transition-all duration-200 ease-out` |
128	
129	### Connector line
130	
131	The connector is a `flex-1` `h-px` div between each pair of circles.
132	
133	- **Completed segment** (connects two completed circles, or completed to active): `flex-1 h-px bg-onyx transition-colors duration-200 ease-out`
134	- **Upcoming segment** (connects active to future, or future to future): `flex-1 h-px bg-border transition-colors duration-200 ease-out`
135	
136	Rule: a segment is "completed" if its left-hand circle is in the completed state. The segment between completed step N and the active step N+1 is completed.
137	
138	On mobile dot mode, connectors are replaced by `mx-1` spacing on each dot — no visible line element.
139	
140	### Labels
141	
142	Rendered below each circle as a sibling `<span>`, not inside the circle container.
143	
144	```
145	Label (active):   font-sans text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.08em]
146	                  text-onyx mt-2 text-center whitespace-nowrap
147	
148	Label (completed/future):  font-sans text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.08em]
149	                            text-stone mt-2 text-center whitespace-nowrap
150	```
151	
152	Label text values (match the step titles):
153	1. "YOUR STUDIO."
154	2. "LOCATION."
155	3. "FIRST SERVICE."
156	4. "LIVE."
157	
158	Labels are hidden on mobile: wrap in `hidden sm:block`.
159	
160	### Step counter text (mobile only)
161	
162	```
163	"Step {currentStep} of 4"
164	font-sans text-[12px] font-semibold text-stone
165	```
166	
167	Hidden at sm and above: `block sm:hidden`.
168	
169	### Component structure (prose, not JSX)
170	
171	The component receives `currentStep` (1-indexed, 1–4) and `steps` (array of 4 label strings). It renders:
172	
173	- Outer wrapper: `flex items-center w-full` (desktop) — on mobile, the wrapper switches to `flex items-center justify-between` to place dots left, counter right.
174	- For each step (1–4): a `flex flex-col items-center` column containing the circle and its label, connected to the next step by the connector div using `flex-1`. The column and connector live inside a `flex items-center w-full` row.
175	
176	### Transition timing
177	
178	All state transitions (idle → active, active → completed) animate via `transition-all duration-200 ease-out` on each circle's className. The Rust ring on the active state appears/disappears with the same 200ms ease-out. No JS animation — pure Tailwind transition utilities driven by class swaps on prop change.
179	
180	### Data contract
181	
182	```
183	Props:
184	  currentStep: number   // 1-indexed (1 = Step 1 active)
185	  steps: string[]       // Array of 4 label strings (uppercase, period-terminated)
186	
187	Emits: nothing (display-only component)
188	```
189	
190	### Accessibility
191	
192	- Wrap in `<nav aria-label="Onboarding progress">`.
193	- Each step item: `role="listitem"`.
194	- Active circle: `aria-current="step"`.
195	- Completed circle: `aria-label="{stepLabel} — completed"`.
196	- Future circle: `aria-label="{stepLabel} — upcoming"`.
197	- The progress row: `role="list"`.
198	- Mobile counter span: `aria-live="polite"` so screen readers announce step changes.
199	- No keyboard interaction — the indicator is display-only; navigation is controlled by the wizard's Continue/Back buttons.
200	
201	### Focus ring
202	
203	No focus ring on this component — it is non-interactive.
204	
205	---
206	
207	## 2. OnboardingWizard
208	
209	**File:** `components/onboarding/OnboardingWizard.tsx`
210	
211	**Purpose:** Card container that wraps the step indicator, step title, and step body. Manages the `currentStep` state and triggers the cross-fade animation between steps.
212	
213	### Layout
214	
215	```
216	[  InkOS wordmark + "Studio OS" subtitle                        ]
217	                       ↕ 32px gap
218	[  StepIndicator (full width)                                   ]
219	                       ↕ 40px gap
220	[  Step title (Instrument Serif, 32px)                          ]
221	[  Step subtitle (Inter 14px, Stone)                            ]
222	                       ↕ 24px gap
223	[  Step body (variable — the active step component)             ]
224	                       ↕ 32px gap
225	[  Back (ghost, left) ←——————————————→ Continue (primary, right)]
226	```
227	
228	### Card frame
229	
230	```
231	Outer wrapper (centers the card on page):
232	  min-h-screen bg-bone flex items-center justify-center px-4 py-8
233	
234	Card:
235	  w-full max-w-lg bg-bone rounded-2xl shadow-soft-md
236	  border border-border
237	  p-8 sm:p-10
238	```
239	
240	`max-w-lg` = 512px. This fits the service template grid (3 columns × narrow cards) and the booking link card without horizontal scroll at 375px (the card goes full-width at small viewport, padded at `px-4`).
241	
242	`rounded-2xl` = `--radius-2xl` = 24px. Matches the large-modal token.
243	
244	`shadow-soft-md` = `0 4px 16px -4px oklch(13% 0.015 85 / 0.10), 0 2px 8px -2px oklch(13% 0.015 85 / 0.07)`. This token is already defined in `globals.css`.
245	
246	**No 3px primary/Rust top bar.** Remove the element at `OnboardingWizard.tsx:110` entirely. The card border is the frame.
247	
248	### Wordmark
249	
250	Position: above the card, centered, 32px margin-bottom.
251	
252	```
253	Horizontal lockup: Onyx tile (32px) + "InkOS" wordmark (Inter 18px/700 text-onyx) +
254	"Studio OS" subtitle below the wordmark (Inter 10px/600 uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-stone)
255	```
256	
257	Class string for the wordmark row: `flex items-center gap-2.5 mb-8`
258	
259	### Spacing between wordmark → indicator → title → body
260	
261	| Gap | Value | Tailwind |
262	|---|---|---|
263	| Wordmark → StepIndicator | 32px | `mb-8` on wordmark wrapper |
264	| StepIndicator → step title | 40px | `mt-10` on title wrapper |
265	| Step title → step subtitle | 4px | `mt-1` |
266	| Step subtitle → step body | 24px | `mt-6` |
267	| Step body → button row | 32px | `mt-8` |
268	
269	### Step body cross-fade animation
270	
271	The step body container renders the active step component with `key={currentStep}`. React will unmount the old step and mount the new one on step change.
272	
273	On the inner step wrapper div, apply these Tailwind classes:
274	```
275	animate-in fade-in-0 slide-in-from-bottom-1 duration-200 ease-out
276	```
277	
278	These classes come from `tw-animate-css` which is already imported in `globals.css`. No additional imports needed.
279	
280	The `StepIndicator` does NOT get `key` — it persists and transitions its circle styles in-place via CSS transitions.
281	
282	### Button row
283	
284	```
285	Layout:       flex items-center justify-between gap-3
286	              flex-row (always — Back and Continue never stack)
287	
288	Back button:  variant="ghost"  size="default"
289	              text-stone text-[14px] font-medium
290	              Conditionally rendered — hidden on Step 1 (no back from first step)
291	              "Back"
292	
293	Skip button:  variant="ghost"  size="default"
294	              text-stone text-[14px] font-medium
295	              Rendered only on steps with skippable fields (Step 2, Step 3)
296	              "Skip for now"
297	              Positioned: pushed right via margin, left of Continue
298	
299	Continue:     variant="default" size="default"
300	              bg-onyx text-bone — this is the default variant per brand
301	              "Continue" on steps 1–3
302	              "Open the studio" on Step 4 (navigates to /dashboard)
303	              Loading label: "Saving…" (no spinner icon under 400ms)
304	              Disabled while server action is in-flight
305	```
306	
307	Button row layout detail — three-state arrangement:
308	
309	- Step 1: `[         ] [Continue →]` (Back hidden, no Skip)
310	- Step 2: `[← Back  ] [Skip for now] [Continue →]` (use `ml-auto` on Skip to push it right of Back)
311	- Step 3: `[← Back  ] [Skip for now] [Continue →]`
312	- Step 4: `[← Back  ] [Open the studio]`
313
